court: Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit

issues.label: Article III standing - individual plaintiffs
issues.why: Court must determine whether plaintiffs who now receive benefits show ongoing injury and redressability.

issues.label: Standing - Empower Missouri diversion of resources
issues.why: Court must assess whether the organization's expenditures establish injury-in-fact under recent precedent.

issues.label: Organizational standing post-Alliance for Hippocratic Medicine
issues.why: Recent Supreme Court law may bar diversion-of-resources theory of organizational standing.

issues.label: Mootness of individual claims
issues.why: Plaintiffs received interviews and benefits, potentially mooting their individual claims.

issues.label: Capable-of-repetition-yet-evading-review exception
issues.why: Court must evaluate whether recurring risk of denial preserves otherwise moot claims.

issues.label: Voluntary cessation doctrine
issues.why: Defendant's post-suit approvals may not moot claims if unlawful policies persist.

issues.label: Substitution of official-capacity defendant
issues.why: Change from Knodell to Bax raises proper party and continuity questions.

issues.label: Private right of action under SNAP Act
issues.why: Court must decide whether 7 U.S.C. §§ 2014, 2020 create enforceable individual rights.

issues.label: Enforceability via 42 U.S.C. § 1983
issues.why: Whether SNAP provisions are enforceable through Section 1983 must be addressed.

issues.label: First-day-to-apply requirement interpretation
issues.why: Court must construe § 2020(e)(2)(B)'s guarantee to apply on first contact.

issues.label: Interview scheduling and 30-day denial policy legality
issues.why: Whether automatic denial for missed interview despite applicant efforts violates SNAP Act.

issues.label: Protected property interest in SNAP benefits
issues.why: Due process claim requires a legitimate entitlement to benefits.

issues.label: Property interest in mere applicants vs recipients
issues.why: Whether applicants (not yet approved) have a protected interest is contested.

issues.label: Procedural due process adequacy
issues.why: Court must apply Mathews v. Eldridge to evaluate process afforded.

issues.label: ADA Title II coverage of SNAP administration
issues.why: Whether DSS's program is a covered public service under the ADA.

issues.label: Qualified individual with a disability
issues.why: Dallas's epilepsy and Holmes's status must meet ADA disability definition.

issues.label: Meaningful access and reasonable accommodation
issues.why: Whether DSS denied meaningful access and failed to accommodate disabilities.

issues.label: Reasonable-accommodation request adequacy
issues.why: Whether Dallas's note and calls constituted proper accommodation requests.

issues.label: Section 504 Rehabilitation Act applicability
issues.why: Relief references Section 504 though claims focus on ADA, requiring analysis.

issues.label: ADA grievance procedure requirement
issues.why: Whether failure to adopt grievance procedures independently violates the ADA.

issues.label: Sovereign immunity / Ex parte Young
issues.why: Official-capacity suit against state director implicates Eleventh Amendment limits.

issues.label: ADA abrogation of state sovereign immunity
issues.why: Whether Title II validly abrogates immunity for these claims.

issues.label: Summary judgment genuine disputes of fact
issues.why: Court must confirm no material factual disputes preclude judgment for either side.

issues.label: Unadmitted federal waiver's evidentiary effect
issues.why: Bax's asserted recertification waiver is not in the record, affecting factual findings.

issues.label: Scope and specificity of injunctive relief
issues.why: Whether detailed operational mandates satisfy Rule 65(d) specificity.

issues.label: Overbreadth of numerical performance mandates
issues.why: Wait-time and denial-rate quotas may exceed remedying proven violations.

issues.label: Federalism and intrusion into state administration
issues.why: Court-ordered management of DSS raises comity and separation-of-powers concerns.

issues.label: Reporting to legislative/executive branch members
issues.why: Requiring reports to other Missouri branches may exceed judicial remedial authority.

issues.label: Standing to seek prospective relief
issues.why: Plaintiffs must show likelihood of future injury for injunctive standing under Lyons.

issues.label: Mandatory injunction requiring 90% wait reduction feasibility
issues.why: Affirmative mandates demand heightened justification and tailoring.

issues.label: Empower Missouri's associational standing
issues.why: Whether organization can sue on members' behalf must be separately analyzed.

issues.label: Regulatory interpretation of SNAP application processes
issues.why: Accompanying federal regulations shape whether DSS's practices are lawful.
